title: pagecue cue file
description: Presenter cues for one web page. Each cue attaches to an element and holds a short headline and speaker notes. Read by the pagecue Chrome extension from <link rel="alternate" type="application/vnd.pagecue+json" href="...">, from an inline <script type="application/vnd.pagecue+json">, or imported by hand.

title.description: Title of the page or presentation.

id.description: Unique, stable id. Without an anchor, the cue attaches to the element with data-pagecue equal to this id.

anchor.description: Which element the cue attaches to: another data-pagecue value, or a full anchor as exported by the extension.

near.description: Instead of an anchor: the exact visible text where the cue starts, usually a heading. For pages whose source cannot be marked with data-pagecue.

title.description: One glanceable line, about eight words.

notes.description: Speaker notes: one point per array item (or per line of a string). At most three short points work best.

startAt.description: Moves where the cue starts on the page, as a share of its section's height: 0.5 starts it half a section later, -0.25 a quarter earlier. Usually set by the presenter dragging the cue's line on the page.

tag.description: Lower-case tag name, or * for any.

text.description: Start of the element's text, used to verify and to fuzzy-match.
